seed.name: alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of pulmonary veins

partners.mechanism_chain: FOXF1 (HGNC:35509) —DISRUPTS→ epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837); epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837) —LEADS_TO→ Alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of pulmonary veins (MONDO:0009934); BMP4 (HGNC:1374) —DISRUPTS→ epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837); epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837) —LEADS_TO→ Orofacial cleft 11 (MONDO:0010906). Haploinsufficiency of FOXF1 disrupts epithelial-mesenchymal transition, contributing to alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of pulmonary veins. Similarly, haploinsufficiency of BMP4 also disrupts epithelial-mesenchymal transition, leading to orofacial cleft 11. The shared convergence on the epithelial-mesenchymal transition pathway links these two distinct developmental disorders.

partners.mechanism_chain: FOXF1 (HGNC:3779) —DISRUPTS→ Embryonic lung development and vascular morphogenesis (GO:0001709); Embryonic lung development and vascular morphogenesis (GO:0001709) —LEADS_TO→ Alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of pulmonary veins (MONDO:0009934); JAG1 (HGNC:6190) —DISRUPTS→ NOTCH signaling pathway (GO:0007219); NOTCH signaling pathway (GO:0007219) —LEADS_TO→ Cardiac defects (HP:0001627); Cardiac defects (HP:0001627) —LEADS_TO→ Tetralogy of Fallot (MONDO:0008542); NOTCH signaling pathway (GO:0007219) —DECREASES→ Embryonic lung development and vascular morphogenesis (GO:0001709). partners.mechanism_chain: FOXF1 (HGNC:3722) —DISRUPTS→ Endothelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001834); Endothelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001834) —LEADS_TO→ Alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of pulmonary veins (MONDO:0009934); GATA4 (HGNC:4158) —DISRUPTS→ Endothelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001834); Endothelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001834) —LEADS_TO→ Ventricular septal defect 1 (MONDO:0013746).
